integrity: Analytical necessary-and-sufficient proof supported by exact symbolic checks; the finite probe set is diagnostic rather than a proof of universal claims.
scientific_limitations: The exact admissibility and dependence extrema apply to two fixed diagonal cosine harmonics only; no global copula extremality or general-frequency result is asserted. Prior literature is not guaranteed exhaustive.
title: Sharp admissibility and hidden rank predictability in a two-harmonic cosine copula
